attack_surface.boundary: keys at rest and in memory

mechanisms_implemented.does_not_guarantee: who that is: any read-key holder can mint such a key (TM-R01)
mechanisms_implemented.guarantees: a commit was signed by a key whose file decrypts under the read key

mechanisms_implemented.does_not_guarantee: directories are 0755 (names visible); not enforced on Windows
mechanisms_implemented.guarantees: every secret goes through Vault__Secret_File: a 0600 temp file renamed into place, no readable window, no inherited mode, a link at the path replaced

redundant_code: store_private_key (private key encrypted under the read key into bare/keys) has no production caller since TM-R02; kept because the adversary fixture and two tests model older clients

secrets_exposure.note: see the dossier for the exact functions; TM-R14/TM-R15 cover keys on argv, stdout and disk

proposed.fix: one private reader beside Vault__Secret_File.write: lstat, refuse a link, O_NOFOLLOW open; use it for the six readers

risk_decision.rationale: awaiting the step-4 verification or a fix

vulnerabilities.title: every secret READER uses plain open() that follows links (load_token, load_vault_key, load_private_key_locally, _load_all, load_clone_mode, load_base_url); the writer replaces a link, the readers follow one

risk_decision.rationale: CLEARED (public keys encrypted under the read key; ids are generated, never user input; a 64-bit random id collision is the register's TM-R07 class)

vulnerabilities.title: store_public_key writes bare/keys/<id> with plain open (umask) and non-atomically; key_id is not validated here (callers generate it with token_hex(8), no collision check)
store_private_key (private key encrypted under the read key into bare/keys) has no production caller since TM-R02; kept because the adversary fixture and two tests model older clients
